summary: Milestone 2 verified: real read-only Kotak Neo adapter + provider factory correctly report NOT_CONFIGURED (no creds in env) while the app keeps serving deterministic MOCK data. Backend: 78/78 in-process pytest tests pass (all existing M1 + new test_broker.py, test_providers.py). New /app/backend/tests/test_m2_public.py (8/8 pass) validates against the public preview URL: /api/system/status expanded fields, /api/broker/kotak/status auth + shape + no secrets, /api/broker/kotak/test-connection auth + minimal 4-key shape, equities carry data_source=mock/data_quality=DEMO/is_live=false, /api/market/overview.market_status is OPEN/PRE_MARKET/CLOSED (Asia/Kolkata), and a global secret-leak sweep across 5 endpoints. Frontend Playwright flow: demo login -> dashboard-data-badge='Demo Market Data', equity-data-badge='Demo Data', Settings shows kotak-connection-panel with kotak-status-badge='NOT CONFIGURED', 'disabled' text present, kotak-test-connection-button click surfaces NOT_CONFIGURED, F&O coming soon visible, no place-order UI anywhere, 12 monitor-idea buttons work, journal loads.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env still has CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with httpOnly cookies + credentials — carried over from M1 iteration_1 review, still not addressed.

routes/system.py::_market_data_status returns 'MOCK'/'KOTAK' from services.DATA_SOURCE, but if a future provider errors mid-request there's no fallback status other than 'ERROR' — consider explicit health probe per request or cached status refresh cadence.

kotak_test_connection uses run_in_threadpool on adapter.authenticate — good; ensure the real Kotak SDK path also has a hard timeout so auth stalls don't hold FastAPI threads indefinitely when creds are later provided.
seed_data_creation: None new for M2 (existing demo journal rows from iteration_1 still present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: M2 endpoints: /api/system/status (public), /api/broker/kotak/status (auth), /api/broker/kotak/test-connection (auth, POST). Overview path is /api/market/overview (NOT /api/overview). /api/equities returns {count, equities:[...]}. Frontend testids confirmed: dashboard-data-badge, equity-data-badge, kotak-connection-panel, kotak-status-badge, kotak-test-connection-button, fno-coming-soon, nav-fo-link (F&O), nav-overview-link (Market Overview), monitor-idea-button-<SYMBOL>. To exercise the real Kotak adapter path against public URL you'd need KOTAK_* creds and MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=kotak in backend/.env + supervisor restart.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions and all M2 acceptance checks pass.
